hooks.name: Test File Conventions Check
hooks.description: When a test file is saved, surfaces the right test command and checks naming conventions.

action.prompt: A test file under tests/ was just saved. Based on its path, remind the user of the correct command: unit tests in tests/unit/ run with `npx jest --testPathPatterns=unit`; Playwright specs (*.spec.ts) run with `npm test`. Then check the file against .kiro/steering/testing-strategy.md conventions: behaviour-describing test names (not "test 1"), one describe block per module/feature, no committed test.only or test.skip, and each test independent with a fresh store instance where applicable. Flag any violations with file:line references. Do not edit the file unless asked.
